notes.title: 6.0 Update
notes.content:
1. Add talent function
2. New elite level
3. Add 4 copies of equipment
4. Add avatar frame
5. Added personal settings: block recruitment information
6. Added the function of querying other players' attributes
7. Added [wooden stake] damage test (arena entry)

notes.title: 5.9 Update
notes.content:
1. Added equipment quality improvement function
2. Added 3 legendary rune positions
3. Added the function of skipping field bosses
4. Added temple gameplay and reset abyss gameplay
5. Monthly card/permanent card gives extra energy
6. The content of treasure summoning is adjusted, and the function of holy objects is enhanced
7. Store content and purchase limit adjustment
8. Battlefield time adjustment
9. Adventurer's Guild and Expedition rewards increased
10. Crystal seed effect improved
11. Main task reset

notes.title: 5.8 new version update
notes.content:
1. New Ultimate Skill for all Job 
2. Added a new drop in the golden dungeon: magic book
3. Increased the number of star gate challenges
4. Newly added public field bosses (calculated daily by ranking)
5. The Year card is converted into a "permanent card" 
6. Add cumulative sign-in rewards
7.Treasure Summon Add Black Iron Box

notes.title: 5.7 Update
notes.content:
1. Maximum offline profit time: 30 days
2. Multiple sets of skill configuration schemes
3. Allow market transactions of level 220 unidentified equipment
4. The Smithy has added synthesis content
5. Increase sign-in rewards
6. Added additional attributes of equipment quality
7. Battlefield chests can be accelerated
8. Added avatar frame
9. New mine output: black iron (dangerous mines support offline collection, death ends)
10. To strengthen equipment, you can use black iron to increase the success rate
11. Adjusted the output type and refresh time of field bosses
